2946-4871-5670-6772.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2946-4871-5670-6772.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5670-6772.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Syr Vondam and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

728-803-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
728-803-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-1116-3249-4549--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

522-5686--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

575-3899-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control two other nontoken creatures that have base power 1 or greater.
575-3899-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the first additional creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the second creature.
When the second creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the second creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the first creature.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the first and second creature by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the second creature.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the second creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 6.

1981-2415-6798-7192.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat.

2557-4365-4826-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3693-4613-6843-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
3693-4613-6843-7803.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Brad Boimler.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1274-4186-6830-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-4186-6830-7810.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

1322-1991-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-1991-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

215-1355-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-1355-7175.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

511-817-3129-4050-7704.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

112-698-4050-7639.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 3 or more life this turn.
112-698-4050-7639.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Clockspinning by paying {U} due to Will.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Clockspinning.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2

3175-5617-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7325.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and that has base toughness 2 or greater.
5686-6972-7325.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-4693-6517.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4693-6517.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1479-2841-6155-6517.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-6155-6517.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1069-3497-7070.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
1069-3497-7070.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The equip ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0}
Repeat.

4924-4943-7070.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Lancers en-Kor.
The Lancers en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Lancers en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Heartless Summoning.
Repeat.

2085-4639-7014.notablePrerequisites: Kelpie Guide and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
2085-4639-7014.description:
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting North Pole Patrol.
Kelpie Guide triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
North Pole Patrol triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.

1477-2866-3518-4986.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

4289-5051-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
4289-5051-5078-6650.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1883-2743-6231.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
1883-2743-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least once this game.
1883-2743-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Replication Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake and Replication Technique's demonstrate ability trigger, copying Replication Technique at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Replication Technique spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

262-1491-2034-6667.description:
Activate Loporrit Scout by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Loporrit Scout triggers, giving Loporrit Scout +1/+1 until end of turn.
Acitvate Loporrit Scout by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

193-1766-3604.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Thran Dynamo.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-1766-3604.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

2468-3094-4821.notablePrerequisites:
Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Nonland mana sources that can tap for at least {4} on the battlefield.
An additional
2468-3094-4821.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Dramatic Reversal without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Dramatic Reversal, untapping all nonland permanents you xontrol.
Repeat from step 2.
Cast Dramatic Reversal, holding priority.
Tap Lithoform Engine and spend {3} to activate the second ability of Lithoform Engine, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Allow the Dramatic Reversal copy to resolve, untapping your nonland permanents.
Tap your nonland mana sources for at least {4}.
Repeat steps 2-4 for an infinite loop.

1029-4360-5028.description:
Activate Greenweaver Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Greenweaver Druid.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-4360-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

3490-4050-6097-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4050-6097-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Hinterland Sanctifier indestructible.
3490-4050-6097-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1724-4304-5612.description:
Cast Sekki by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Sekki enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Kudo.
Ayula triggers, causing Sekki to fight a creature you don't control.
Sekki removes a number of +1/+1 counters from it equal to the damage it would've been dealt and creates that many 1/1 Spirit creature tokens, which are Bears due to Kudo.
When the Spirit Bear(s) enter the battlefield, Ayula triggers that many times.
If Sekki is on the battlefield, resolve an Ayula trigger, causing Sekki to fight a creature you don't control, and then repeat from step 3.
If Sekki is not on the battlefield, activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Bear with eight +1/+1 counters on it due to Kudo.
If Sekki entered the battlefield, Ayula triggers, causing Sekki to fight a creature you don't control.
Repeat from step 3.
1724-4304-5612.notes: You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under your control.

3887-4050-5851.manaNeeded: {12}{B} at most, depending on how many Stormsplitters you control
3887-4050-5851.description:
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {4}{B}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve Lab Rats, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {B}.
If you control at least 8 Stormsplitters, activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Stormsplitter tokens, adding {4}.
Repeat.

851-5189-5641.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
851-5189-5641.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate an Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1912-3488-4131.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
1912-3488-4131.description:
Activate Katsumasa by paying {2}{U}, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

608-1270-2022-2034-5495.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
It is your turn.
608-1270-2022-2034-5495.description:
Activate Thallid Soothsayer by paying {2} and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card.
An opponent's Wedding Ring's second ability triggers, causing them to draw a card.
Xyris' first ability triggers, creating three 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Snake, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1525-2178-3585-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zimone and Dina.
1525-2178-3585-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zimone and Dina triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Zimone and Dina ability from step 1, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Greensleeves triggers for each land that enters the battlefield this way, creating that many 3/3 Badger creature tokens.
Repeat.

1992-2438-2744.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-2438-2744.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter, Carrion Feeder gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability by dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
